cron.description: 6-field Quartz cron of the push tick (AFFINITY_PUSH_CRON). Cron runs in UTC.

description.purpose: The tick of the push lane. It sends, it decides nothing: whether a subscriber hears anything is ./push's comparison, not this cell's schedule.
description.use_when: Inside the affinity hive; change the cadence at runtime with add/modify/remove ops by schedule_id.
description.not_in_scope: No catch-up. A missed firing is dropped, and costs nothing: the next tick compares the same hashes and reaches the same subscribers.
description.emits_meaning: A plain trigger. The lane's state starts empty, which is exactly how ./push recognises the start of a tick.
description.consumes_meaning: Schedule ops (add/modify/remove by schedule_id) as body.op.
examples: every five minutes -> ./push; nothing changed -> nothing leaves the hive
